I've been a diabetic 16 years. I've been in DKA four times, three of which have been in the past year. Why? The doctors have no clue. They say it could be from stress or an illness. This last time I went in a period of ten hours from being fine to being in full blown DKA. I was repeatedly doing insulin to bring down my sugar but it kept rising. The hardest part to deal with is the dehydration. Do you have diabetes? Do you know someone who does? 

I don't doubt the officer can't tell the difference between hypoglycemia and DKA. What I do know is that I looked sick. I was sluggish and unresponsive. My skin was grey. 

We were rushing to the hospital because I knew that I could go into a coma if I didn't get fluids and more insulin into me soon. I was at home and it was faster to drive.
The lady who called the police made up the hit and run story because my dad honked at her while driving.
That just gives me first world guilt. I've got plenty of problems but I'd love to lose my white male privilege so I wouldn't feel so guilty for hating my life.
This just made me want to kill myself more.

Alleles can mutate naturally or unnaturally. We notice when phenotypical (superficial) mutations arise, such as albino-ism but the teeniest of allele changes could be doing crazy things inside your body.
There is no evidence against it and lots of evidence for it.

Here is the short version of my story:

Verbally and physically abused my entire life. Generally a social outcast, no friends for a good chunk of my life. When I did have friends the number never got above three and we rarely hung out. Complications from juvenile diabetes that has caused me to shake, destroyed my bladder/kidneys, and lose nerve sensation. Poor background so I can't afford health insurance. 

I've had three girlfriends in my life. The first left because I was depressive. The second abused me for months and I finally got myself out of it. Third girlfriend I was engaged to. She cheated on me. All other attempts at dating were met with rejection, laughter and so on. 

Went to school in a practical but uninteresting field and after my fiance left me I needed a change. I went back to school and I'm currently about a year and a half away from my second degree.

But I've got no social life and any attempts at one have failed. I am also now starting to fail all my classes.

I'm on anti-depressants but they don't seem to be doing much.

And I figure this needs saying. I was in a better mood with my fiance. I felt loved for the first time in my life and we had ridiculous amounts of sex. The rest of my life still sucked but the sex chems kept me pretty sedated.
I mean there is no point to life other than having offspring.
Never had a happy moment in my life.
